<details>
<summary><strong>Test Case 1: WAN IP and MAC match Android RNDIS interface values</strong></summary>

## Test Case 1: TS_RNDIS_VerifyWANIPAndMAC_AndroidUSB

## Objectives
Verify that the WAN IP and MAC address reported by the TR-181 data model match the actual values of the Android RNDIS WAN interface.

## Test Case ID
TC_RNDIS_1

## Test Type
Positive

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test |
| Android USB â€“ Android phone connected to DUT via USB with USB Tethering enabled |

## Test Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| None | &nbsp; |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number | DUT | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| <small>1</small> | <small>Verify the usb0 interface has an active IP address assigned (prerequisite)</small> | <small>Verify the usb0 interface has a valid inet addr. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>2</small> | <small>Get the MAC address of the usb0 interface</small> | <small>Verify the MAC address of the usb0 interface is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>3</small> | <small>GET Device.DeviceInfo.X_COMCAST-COM_WAN_IP</small> | <small>Verify the WAN IP value is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>4</small> | <small>GET Device.DeviceInfo.X_COMCAST-COM_WAN_MAC</small> | <small>Verify the WAN MAC value is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>5</small> | <small>Verify Device.DeviceInfo.X_COMCAST-COM_WAN_IP matches the usb0 interface IP address</small> | <small>Verify both IP addresses match. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>6</small> | <small>Verify Device.DeviceInfo.X_COMCAST-COM_WAN_MAC matches the usb0 interface MAC address</small> | <small>If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |

</details>

---

<details>
<summary><strong>Test Case 2: Gateway internet connectivity via Android USB tethering with zero packet loss</strong></summary>

|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|

<details>
<summary><strong>Test Case 3: Cellular interface toggling transitions status between DEREGISTERED and CONNECTED via Android USB</strong></summary>

## Test Case 3: TS_RNDIS_VerifyCellularInterfaceToggling_AndroidUSB

## Objectives
Verify that disabling and re-enabling the cellular interface via the data model correctly transitions the cellular status between Deregistered and Connected states.

## Test Case ID
TC_RNDIS_3

## Test Type
Positive

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test |
| Android USB â€“ Android phone connected to DUT via USB with USB Tethering enabled |

## Test Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.Cellular.Interface.1.Enable | false/true |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number | DUT | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| <small>1</small> | <small>Verify the usb0 interface has an active IP address (prerequisite)</small> | <small>Verify the usb0 interface has a valid inet addr. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>2</small> | <small>GET Device.Cellular.Interface.1.Enable and save the original value</small> | <small>Verify the value is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>3</small> | <small>SET Device.Cellular.Interface.1.Enable to false; GET Device.Cellular.Interface.1.Enable and verify the value is false</small> | <small>Verify the SET succeeded and the retrieved value is false. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>4</small> | <small>GET Device.Cellular.X_RDK_Status and verify the value is DEREGISTERED</small> | <small>Verify Device.Cellular.X_RDK_Status is DEREGISTERED. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>5</small> | <small>SET Device.Cellular.Interface.1.Enable to true; GET Device.Cellular.Interface.1.Enable and verify the value is true</small> | <small>Verify the SET succeeded and the retrieved value is true. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>6</small> | <small>GET Device.Cellular.X_RDK_Status and verify the value is CONNECTED</small> | <small>Verify Device.Cellular.X_RDK_Status is CONNECTED. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>7</small> | <small>Monitor Device.Cellular.X_RDK_Status for 300 seconds (polling every 30 seconds) and verify the status remains CONNECTED throughout the monitoring period</small> | <small>If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |

</details>

<summary><strong>Test Case 1: TS_Telemetry2_0_CheckTelemetryProcessAfterDisable</strong></summary>

## Test Case 1: TS_Telemetry2_0_CheckTelemetryProcessAfterDisable

## Objectives

Validate whether the telemetry2 process can be disabled by setting Device.DeviceInfo.X_RDKCENTRAL-COM_RFC.Feature.Telemetry.Enable to false. After a reboot, the telemetry2_0 process should not be running on the DUT.

## Test Case ID

TC_TELEMETRY2.0_52

## Test Type

Positive

## Test Environment

| Component                                  |
| ------------------------------------------ |
| DUT - Device under test |

## Test Configuration

| Parameter                                                       | Value |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| Device.DeviceInfo.X_RDKCENTRAL-COM_RFC.Feature.Telemetry.Enable | false |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number      | DUT                                                                                                           | TDK Validation and Expected Results                                                                                                                                           |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <small>1</small> | <small>GET Device.DeviceInfo.X_RDKCENTRAL-COM_RFC.Feature.Telemetry.Enable and save the initial value</small> | <small>Verify GET operation is successful and the value is retrieved. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small>                                                     |
| <small>2</small> | <small>SET Device.DeviceInfo.X_RDKCENTRAL-COM_RFC.Feature.Telemetry.Enable to false</small>                   | <small>Verify SET operation is successful. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small>                                                                                |
| <small>3</small> | <small>Reboot the DUT to apply the configuration change</small>                                               | <small>Verify DUT restarts and comes back up successfully by checking that Device.DeviceInfo.UpTime is greater than 0. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small>    |
| <small>4</small> | <small>Check if the telemetry2_0 process is running on the DUT using pidof command</small>                    | <small>Verify the telemetry2_0 process is not running (PID is empty). If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small>                                                     |
| <small>5</small> | <small>Revert Device.DeviceInfo.X_RDKCENTRAL-COM_RFC.Feature.Telemetry.Enable to original value</small>       | <small>Verify Device.DeviceInfo.X_RDKCENTRAL-COM_RFC.Feature.Telemetry.Enable is reverted to original value successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>6</small> | <small>Reboot the DUT to apply the reverted configuration</small>                                             | <small>Verify DUT restarts and comes back up successfully after applying the reverted configuration. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small>                          |

</details>

---

<summary><strong>Test Case 2: TS_Telemetry2_0_CheckTelemetryProcessAfterFR</strong></summary>

## Test Case 2: TS_Telemetry2_0_CheckTelemetryProcessAfterFR

## Objectives

Validate whether the telemetry2 process is running after a Factory Reset of the DUT. The telemetry2_0 process should be in a running state after the device comes back up following a factory reset.

## Test Case ID

TC_TELEMETRY2.0_53

## Test Type

Positive

## Test Environment

| Component                                  |
| ------------------------------------------ |
| DUT - Device under test |

## Test Configuration

| Parameter                                     | Value                      |
| --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.FactoryReset | Router,Wifi,VoIP,Dect,MoCA |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number      | DUT                                                                                                                         | TDK Validation and Expected Results                                                                                   |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <small>1</small> | <small>SET Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.FactoryReset to "Router,Wifi,VoIP,Dect,MoCA" to trigger a Factory Reset</small> | <small>Verify Factory Reset is triggered successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small>            |
| <small>2</small> | <small>Wait for the DUT to come back up after Factory Reset</small>                                                         | <small>&nbsp;</small>                                                                                                 |
| <small>3</small> | <small>Check if the telemetry2_0 process is running on the DUT using pidof command</small>                                  | <small>Verify the telemetry2_0 process is running (PID is not empty). If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Test Case 3: Verify SIGSEGV on non-CCSP process creates a minidump and the process self-recovers</strong></summary>

## Test Case 3: TS_CrashUpload_NonCCSPProcessCrash

## Objectives
Validate the crash handling mechanism for non-CCSP processes by intentionally inducing a segmentation fault (SIGSEGV) on the fwupgrademanager process and confirming that a minidump (.dmp) file is created in the /minidumps directory and the process self-recovers with a new PID.

## Test Case ID
TC_CrashUpload_3

## Test Type
Positive

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test |

## Test Configuration

None

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number | DUT | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| <small>1</small> | <small>Set core dump size to unlimited on the DUT (ulimit -c unlimited)</small> | <small>Verify core dump size is set to unlimited. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>2</small> | <small>Get the active state of the coredump-upload.path unit on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify coredump-upload.path is in active (waiting) state. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>3</small> | <small>Get the initial count of .dmp files in the /minidumps directory on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify initial .dmp file count is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>4</small> | <small>Get the PID of the fwupgrademanager process on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify a valid PID is obtained for fwupgrademanager. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>5</small> | <small>Kill the fwupgrademanager process with SIGSEGV signal (kill -11 &lt;PID&gt;) on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify the process is killed successfully with SIGSEGV. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>6</small> | <small>Verify that a new .dmp file is created in the /minidumps directory on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify the .dmp file count has increased from the initial count. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>7</small> | <small>Verify fwupgrademanager process has restarted on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify fwupgrademanager is running with a new PID different from the original. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>8</small> | <small>Cleanup: Revert core dump size (ulimit) to the initial value</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |

</details>

| <small>15</small> | <small>Verify fwupgrademanager process has restarted on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify fwupgrademanager is running with a new PID different from the original. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |

<details>
<summary><strong>DAC - Bundle Management</strong></summary>

# DAC - Bundle Management

<details>
<summary><strong>Test Case 5: Verify DAC bundle install and ExecutionUnit activation via USP-PA</strong></summary>

## Test Case 5: TS_DAC_VerifyUSPPABundleInstallAndActivation

## Objectives
Verify that a DAC bundle can be installed and activated via USP-PA, and that the resulting container runs as an active ExecutionUnit. The test installs an OCI bundle via USP-PA, verifies its presence in the destination directory, updates the iperf3 server IP in the bundle configuration, activates the ExecutionUnit, confirms the container is listed as running via DobbyTool, and validates that the ExecutionUnit status is Active.

## Test Case ID
TC_DAC_07

## Test Type
Positive

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test |
| Local HTTP file server - Hosts OCI bundle for download |

## Test Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.SoftwareModules.InstallDU | As per test configuration |
| Device.SoftwareModules.ExecutionUnit.{i}.SetRequestedState | Active |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number | DUT | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| <small>1</small> | <small>Install DAC bundle on the DUT via USP-PA using the configured bundle download URL</small> | <small>Verify bundle installation started successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>2</small> | <small>Wait for bundle installation to complete</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| <small>3</small> | <small>Verify the installed application bundle directory and config file are present in the destination directory on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify installed app bundle is present in the destination directory. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>4</small> | <small>Update the iperf3 server IP in the bundle config.json file at the installation destination on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify config.json is updated with the iperf3 server IP successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>5</small> | <small>SET the ExecutionUnit requested state parameter to activate the ExecutionUnit via USP-PA on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify ExecutionUnit activation request completed successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>6</small> | <small>Wait 10 seconds for activation to take effect</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| <small>7</small> | <small>List running Dobby containers using DobbyTool on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify the container is listed in DobbyTool output. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>8</small> | <small>GET ExecutionUnit.{i}.Status from the DUT</small> | <small>Verify ExecutionUnit.{i}.Status is Active. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>9</small> | <small>Cleanup: Uninstall the DeploymentUnit via USP-PA on the DUT</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |

</details>

---

| <small>3</small> | <small>Verify first bundle directory is present in the destination directory on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify first bundle is present in the destination directory. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>4</small> | <small>GET DeploymentUnit.{i}.URL for the first DeploymentUnit from the DUT</small> | <small>Verify first DeploymentUnit URL matches the first configured bundle download URL. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>5</small> | <small>GET DeploymentUnit.{i}.Status for the first DeploymentUnit from the DUT</small> | <small>Verify first DeploymentUnit Status is Installed. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>6</small> | <small>Install second DAC bundle on the DUT via USP-PA using the second configured bundle download URL</small> | <small>Verify second bundle installation started successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>7</small> | <small>Wait for second bundle installation to complete</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| <small>8</small> | <small>Verify second bundle directory is present in the destination directory on the DUT</small> | <small>Verify second bundle is present in the destination directory. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>9</small> | <small>GET DeploymentUnit.{i}.URL for the second DeploymentUnit from the DUT</small> | <small>Verify second DeploymentUnit URL matches the second configured bundle download URL. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>10</small> | <small>GET DeploymentUnit.{i}.Status for the second DeploymentUnit from the DUT</small> | <small>Verify second DeploymentUnit Status is Installed. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>11</small> | <small>Cleanup: Uninstall second DeploymentUnit via USP-PA on the DUT</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| <small>12</small> | <small>Cleanup: Uninstall first DeploymentUnit via USP-PA on the DUT</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |

## Test Case 27: E2E_PortTriggering_WANtoLAN_BOTH_TargetFTP

### Objectives
To check if the Port Triggering rule in GW takes effect so that an inbound packet with target port 21 is forwarded to the LAN machine (which is running an FTP server) after it sends an outbound packet through the GW that triggers the 12345 port configured in the rule with protocol as BOTH.
### Test Type
Positive

### Test Environment
| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test |
| LAN Client - Wired client |
| WAN - WAN system |

### Test Configuration
| Parameter | Value |

| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.TriggerProtocol | BOTH |
| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.TriggerPortStart | 12345 |
| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.TriggerPortEnd | 12345 |
| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.ForwardProtocol | BOTH |
| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.ForwardPortStart | 21 |
| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.ForwardPortEnd | 21 |
| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.Description | MyPTRule |
| Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.Enable | true |

|-------------|-----|------------|------------|-------------------------------------|

| <small>4</small> | <small>ADD a new instance to the Port Triggering rule table - Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}</small> |  |  | <small>A new Port Triggering rule instance is added successfully. If the condition is met, then CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| <small>5</small> | <small>SET the Port Triggering rule parameters - Trigger protocol for outbound packets Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.TriggerProtocol, Starting port Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.TriggerPortStart, Ending port Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.TriggerPortEnd, Forward protocol for inbound packets Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.ForwardProtocol, Forward starting port Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.ForwardPortStart, Forward ending port Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.ForwardPortEnd, A description of the rule added Device.NAT.X_CISCO_COM_PortTriggers.Trigger.{i}.Description</small> |  |  | <small>Port Triggering rule parameters are set to the configured values. <summary><strong>Test Case 123: Allow WLAN client internet access via MAC-based parental control</strong></summary>

## Test Case 123: E2E_ParentalControl_ManagedDevices_Allow_WLAN

---

## Objectives

Verify that the Wireless Gateway (WG) allows specific Wi-Fi clients associated over WLAN based on MAC address through Parental Control (Managed Devices). When Managed Devices is enabled with AllowAll set to true and a device rule of type "Allow" is configured for the WLAN client's MAC address, the WLAN client must be able to access the internet.

---

## Test Case ID

TC_TDKB_E2E_823

---

## Test Type

Positive

---

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test|
| WLAN Client - Wireless client |
| WAN - WAN system |

---

## Test Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID | As per test configuration |
| Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Enable | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.AllowAll | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.Type | Allow |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.Description | rootNAT |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.MACAddress | As per test configuration (WLAN client MAC) |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.AlwaysBlock | false |

---

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number | DUT | WLAN Client | WAN system | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Enable and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.AllowAll using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the TR-181 GET request returns SUCCESS and the current values of all four parameters are retrieved and saved for later revert. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 2 | <small>Configure Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID (if required), Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase (if required), Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Enable to true, and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.AllowAll to true via TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that all TR-181 SET requests return SUCCESS and all four parameters are successfully written to the DUT. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 3 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Enable and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.AllowAll using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the retrieved values match the values set in Step 2 (SSID=configured SSID, KeyPassphrase=configured password, Enable=true, AllowAll=true). If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 4 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Connect to the Wi-Fi SSID using the configured credentials</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client successfully connects to the Wi-Fi network. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 5 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address assigned to the WLAN client interface after connecting to Wi-Fi</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client has been assigned a valid IP address. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 6 | <small>Get Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the TR-181 GET returns SUCCESS and the gateway LAN IP address is retrieved. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 7 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Check that the WLAN client IP address is within the DHCP range of the gateway</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client IP address falls within the gateway's DHCP range (same subnet as Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress). If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 8 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the MAC address of the WLAN client interface</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the MAC address of the WLAN client is successfully retrieved. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 9 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Disconnect from the Wi-Fi SSID</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client successfully disconnects from the Wi-Fi network. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 10 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that a new managed device rule entry is added successfully and a valid instance index (greater than 0) is returned. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 11 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.Type to "Allow", Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.Description to "rootNAT", Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.MACAddress to the WLAN client MAC address, and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.AlwaysBlock to false via TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that all TR-181 SET requests return SUCCESS and all four rule parameters are successfully written to the DUT. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 12 | <small>Get Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.Type, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.Description, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.MACAddress and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.AlwaysBlock using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the retrieved values match what was set in Step 11 (Type="Allow", Description="rootNAT", MACAddress=WLAN client MAC, AlwaysBlock=false). If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 13 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Connect to the Wi-Fi SSID using the configured credentials</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client successfully reconnects to the Wi-Fi network after the managed device rule was added. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 14 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address assigned to the WLAN client interface after reconnecting to Wi-Fi</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client has been assigned a valid IP address. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 15 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Check that the WLAN client IP address is within the DHCP range of the gateway</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client IP address falls within the gateway's DHCP range. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 16 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Refresh the Wi-Fi network availability (check that the SSID is visible)</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the SSID is available and the Wi-Fi network is refreshed successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 17 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Add a static route on the WLAN client to reach the WAN URL via the gateway IP</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is successfully added on the WLAN client. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 18 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Initiate an HTTP (WGET_HTTP) connection from the WLAN client to the WAN URL via the gateway</small> | <small>Respond to the HTTP request from the WLAN client</small> | <small>Verify that the HTTP connection from the WLAN client to the WAN URL is SUCCESSFUL, confirming that the allowed device has internet access. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |
| 19 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Delete the static route that was added in Step 17</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is successfully deleted from the WLAN client. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 20 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Disconnect from the Wi-Fi SSID</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client successfully disconnects from the Wi-Fi network. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 21 | <small>Delete entry Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Device.{i}.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the managed device rule entry added in Step 10 is successfully deleted from the DUT. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 22 | <small>Revert Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID (if required), Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase (if required), Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.Enable, and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedDevices.AllowAll to their original values saved in Step 1 via TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that all four parameters are successfully reverted to their original values. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |


</details>

| 9 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the LAN client IP address is within the DHCP range of the gateway.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the LAN client IP is within the gateway's DHCP range. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 10 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Add a static route on the LAN client to reach the WAN HTTP server via the gateway IP.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the static route is added successfully on the LAN client. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |

# Managed Services - WLAN

<details>
<summary><strong>Test Case 137: Block HTTP service for WLAN client via parental control</strong></summary>

## Test Case 137: E2E_ParentalControl_ManagedServices_WLAN_Block_HTTP

---

## Objectives

Verify that the Wireless Gateway (WG) supports blocking of HTTP service for a Wi-Fi Client associated over WLAN through Parental Control (Managed Services). When the HTTP service blocking rule is configured and Managed Services is enabled, the WLAN client must not be able to access the internet using HTTP.

---

## Test Case ID

TC_TDKB_E2E_830

---

## Test Type

Negative

---

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test|
| WLAN Client - Wireless client |
| WAN - WAN system |

---

## Test Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID | As per test configuration |
| Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Enable | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.Description | http |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.Protocol | BOTH |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.StartPort | 80 |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.EndPort | 8080 |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.AlwaysBlock | true |

---

| Step Number | DUT | WLAN Client | WAN system | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Enable using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the TR-181 GET request returns SUCCESS and the current values of all three parameters are retrieved and saved for later revert. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 2 | <small>Set Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID to the configured SSID name, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase to the configured password and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Enable to true via TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that all TR-181 SET requests return SUCCESS and all three parameters are successfully written to the DUT. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 3 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Enable using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the retrieved values match the values set in Step 2 (SSID=configured SSID, KeyPassphrase=configured password, Enable=true). If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 4 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that a new service blocking rule entry is added successfully and a valid instance index (greater than 0) is returned. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 5 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.Description to "http", Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.Protocol to "BOTH", Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.StartPort to 80, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.EndPort to 8080 and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.AlwaysBlock to true via TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that all TR-181 SET requests return SUCCESS and all fields of the added rule are successfully written to the DUT. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 6 | <small>Get Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.Description, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.Protocol, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.StartPort, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.EndPort and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.AlwaysBlock using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the retrieved values match the values set in Step 5 (Description="http", Protocol="BOTH", StartPort=80, EndPort=8080, AlwaysBlock=true). If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 7 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Connect to the Wi-Fi SSID using the configured credentials</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client successfully connects to the Wi-Fi network. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 8 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address assigned to the WLAN client interface after connecting to Wi-Fi</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client has been assigned a valid IP address. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 9 | <small>Get Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress using TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the TR-181 GET returns SUCCESS and the gateway LAN IP address is retrieved. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 10 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Check that the WLAN client IP address is within the DHCP range of the gateway</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client IP address falls within the gateway's DHCP range (same subnet as Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress). If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 11 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Refresh the Wi-Fi SSID availability on the WLAN client</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the SSID is available and the Wi-Fi network list is refreshed successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 12 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Add a static route on the WLAN client to reach the WAN HTTP server via the gateway IP</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is successfully added on the WLAN client. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 13 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Initiate an HTTP connection from the WLAN client to the WAN HTTP server</small> | <small>Respond to the HTTP request from the WLAN client</small> | <small>Verify that the HTTP connection attempt FAILS, confirming that the HTTP service is blocked for the WLAN client by the parental control rule. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |
| 14 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Delete the static route added in Step 12</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is successfully deleted from the WLAN client. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 15 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Disconnect from the Wi-Fi SSID</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client successfully disconnects from the Wi-Fi network. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 16 | <small>Delete entry Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Service.{i}.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the service blocking rule entry added in Step 4 is successfully deleted from the DUT. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL</small> |
| 17 | <small>Revert Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedServices.Enable to their original values saved in Step 1 via TR-181</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that all three parameters are successfully reverted to their original values. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL</small> |


</details>

## Test Case 152: E2E_ParentalControl_ManagedSites_Block_WebsiteKeyword_TrustedLANClient

## Objectives
Verify that the Wireless Gateway (WG) supports blocking of websites using keyword through Parental Control (Managed Sites) while allowing HTTP connectivity for trusted LAN clients.

## Test Case ID
TC_TDKB_E2E_474

## Test Type
Positive

## Test Environment
| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test|
| LAN Client - Wired client |

## Test Configuration
| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod | Keyword |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.HostDescription | LanClient |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddressType | IPv4 |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddress | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.Trusted | true |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results
| Step Number | DUT | LAN Client | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Ensure the LAN client is connected and has an IP address assigned by the gateway DHCP.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| 2 | <small>Get Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the current value is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 3 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable = true using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable is set to true. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 4 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify a new BlockedSite instance is created successfully and a valid instance index is returned. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 5 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site, and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify BlockMethod, Site, and AlwaysBlock are set to the configured values. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 6 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address of the LAN client.</small> | <small>Verify the LAN client IP address is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 7 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify a new TrustedUser instance is created successfully and a valid instance index is returned. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 8 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.HostDescription, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddressType, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.IPAddress, and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.Trusted using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify HostDescription, IPAddressType, IPAddress, and Trusted are set to the configured values. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 9 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address of the LAN client.</small> | <small>Verify the LAN client IP address is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 10 | <small>Get Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the Gateway LAN IP address is retrieved successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 11 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the LAN client IP address is in the same DHCP range as the gateway IP. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 12 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Add a static route on the LAN client to route traffic for the website URL via the gateway IP.</small> | <small>Verify the static route is added successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 13 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Attempt HTTP (wget) access from the trusted LAN client to the website URL containing the blocked keyword.</small> | <small>Verify that the trusted LAN client can successfully access the website URL containing the blocked keyword via HTTP. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 14 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Delete the static route added for the website URL from the LAN client.</small> | <small>Verify the static route is deleted successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 15 | <small>Delete the added entry from Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.TrustedUser.{i}.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the TrustedUser entry is deleted successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 16 | <small>Delete the added entry from Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the BlockedSite entry is deleted successfully. If the condition is met CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 17 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable to revert it to its original value using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable is reverted to its original value. If the condition is met PASS, else FAIL.</small> |


</details>

## Objectives

## Test Case ID
TC_TDKB_E2E_839

## Test Type
Negative

## Test Environment

| Component |
|-----------|
| DUT - Device under test|
| WLAN Client - Wireless client |

## Test Configuration

| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID | As per test configuration |
| Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable | true |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod | URL |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site | As per test configuration |
| Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock | true |

## Test Procedure and Expected Results

| Step Number | DUT | WLAN Client | TDK Validation and Expected Results |
|---|------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable using TR-181. Save the retrieved original values.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If values are retrieved successfully CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 2 | <small>Set Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID and Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase using TR-181. Then set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable = true using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If both SET operations are successful CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 3 | <small>Get Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID, Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the retrieved values match the values set in Step 2. If values match CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 4 | <small>Add new entry to Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that a new instance is created in Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite. and a valid instance number is returned. If new instance is created CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 5 | <small>Set Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod = URL, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock = true using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If SET is successful CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 6 | <small>Get Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.BlockMethod, Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.Site and Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}.AlwaysBlock using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify the retrieved values match the values set in Step 5. If values match CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 7 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Connect to the WiFi SSID configured in Step 2.</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client connects to the WiFi SSID successfully. If connected CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 8 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Get the IP address assigned to the WLAN interface.</small> | <small>Verify that an IP address is assigned to the WLAN client. If IP address is retrieved CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 9 | <small>Get Device.X_CISCO_COM_DeviceControl.LanManagementEntry.1.LanIPAddress using TR-181.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If value is retrieved successfully CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 10 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client IP address is within the DHCP range of the gateway LAN IP. If WLAN IP is in the LAN DHCP range CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 11 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Refresh the WiFi network on the WLAN client.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> |
| 12 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Add a static route on the WLAN client to reach the blocked URL via the gateway IP address.</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is added successfully. If added CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 13 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Attempt HTTP access to the blocked URL using wget.</small> | <small>Verify that the HTTP connection to the blocked URL is blocked. If HTTP connection is blocked PASS, else FAIL.</small> |
| 14 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Delete the static route added in Step 12.</small> | <small>Verify that the static route is deleted successfully. If deleted CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 15 | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Disconnect from the WiFi SSID.</small> | <small>Verify that the WLAN client disconnects from the SSID successfully. If disconnected CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 16 | <small>Delete the added Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.BlockedSite.{i}. entry.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>Verify that the blocked site rule is deleted successfully. If deleted CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 17 | <small>Revert Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID and Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.Security.KeyPassphrase to their original values saved in Step 1.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If reverted CONTINUE, else FAIL.</small> |
| 18 | <small>Revert Device.X_Comcast_com_ParentalControl.ManagedSites.Enable to its original value saved in Step 1.</small> | <small>&nbsp;</small> | <small>If reverted PASS, else FAIL.</small> |


</details>
